candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool.size=5 with pool.idle=0 and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order POST /v1/orders to return 503 and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502 after ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres server-side metrics or pool wait-time data; pool exhaustion inferred from idle=0 and DependencyUnavailable errors.

report.explanation: Traces across three correlation IDs consistently show postgres.save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable while pool.size=5 and pool.idle=0, propagating 503 from order and 502 at gateway checkout with ~2s durations. Metrics confirm elevated /v1/checkout 502 rate and p95 ~2406ms. Topology confirms order->postgresql dependency. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion.
